title: RimWorld
summary: A colony survival sim on a generated rimworld, where a small group of crash-landed or stranded colonists survives through work, seasons, weather, and local threats.
world_rules: Time advances as an absolute tick counter that is saved with the colony; there is no separate calendar mapping in this integration.
A colonist is a named, humanlike member of the player's own faction. Prisoners, guests, enemies, animals and mechanoids are not colonists.
Colonists have needs such as food, rest and recreation that decay over time, and a mood that reflects how well those needs are met.
Traits, backgrounds and skills are properties of the generated colonist, and they shape how that colonist works and speaks.
A colonist may be present on a map or travelling off-map in a caravan; different colonists may be on different maps.
lore: The rimworld is a procedurally generated planet at the edge of known space.
Colonists arrive by crash, shipwreck or wanderer and build shelter from local materials.
Trade, raiders, weather and disease are ordinary parts of colony life.
narrative_constraints: Stay grounded in the current observation and the current event.
Speak as this specific colonist: their traits, background and skills are the reason they say what they say.
Do not invent events, colonists, places or relationships that the observation does not show.
Keep dialogue concise and in the register of a person surviving on a frontier, not of a narrator.
